name: prompt-shields-chrome-extension
description: Chrome extension that provides user-approved autocorrect suggestions for sensitive data

scripts.build:all: npm run build:chrome && npm run build:edge
scripts.build:all:dev: npm run build:chrome:dev && npm run build:edge:dev
scripts.build:complete: npm run clean && npm run build:all && npm run verify
scripts.build:complete:dev: npm run clean && npm run build:all:dev && npm run verify
scripts.build:complete:chrome: npm run clean:chrome && npm run build:chrome && npm run verify:chrome
scripts.build:complete:chrome:dev: npm run clean:chrome && npm run build:chrome:dev && npm run verify:chrome
scripts.build:complete:edge: npm run clean:edge && npm run build:edge && npm run verify:edge
scripts.build:complete:edge:dev: npm run clean:edge && npm run build:edge:dev && npm run verify:edge
scripts.dev: npm run clean:chrome && npm run build:chrome:dev
scripts.dev:edge: npm run clean:edge && npm run build:edge:dev
scripts.prod: npm run clean && npm run build:all
scripts.prod:chrome: npm run clean:chrome && npm run build:chrome
scripts.prod:edge: npm run clean:edge && npm run build:edge
scripts.postbuild:chrome: npm run copy:chrome && npm run verify:chrome
scripts.postbuild:chrome:dev: npm run copy:chrome && npm run verify:chrome
scripts.postbuild:edge: npm run copy:edge && npm run verify:edge
scripts.postbuild:edge:dev: npm run copy:edge && npm run verify:edge
scripts.copy:all: npm run copy:chrome && npm run copy:edge

author: PromptShields Team
